title: Paeoniflorin Alleviates LPS-Induced Inflammation and Acute Myocardial Injury by Inhibiting PI3K/Akt/ERK-Mediated HIF-1alpha and TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB Inflammatory Signaling.
authors: Guo, Xiaowu; Han, Zhiguang; Sun, Jiahuan; Liu, Shupeng; Zhang, Chuang; Xu, Gengrui; Wang, Xiaodan; Song, Qiuhang; Yang, Hongxia; Li, Aiying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芍药苷通过抑制PI3K/Akt/ERK和TLR4/MyD88/NF-kB信号通路缓解脓毒症心肌损伤，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Sepsis-induced myocardial injury (SIMI) greatly increases the mortality rate of sepsis. Although paeoniflorin (PF) has been proven to improve survival in sepsis, the detailed mechanism of PF on SIMI remains elusive. In this study, network pharmacology revealed 90 overlapping targets between PF- and SIMI-related targets. Analysis using the molecular complex detection (MCODE) method identified a significant module with scores exceeding 30, comprising the top 10 targets: Akt1, STAT3, CASP3, BCL2, TP53, PTGS2, CXCL8, TLR4, CCL2, and ICAM1. These targets are involved in tissue repair during inflammatory response, apoptosis, immunity, and lipopolysaccharide (LPS) immune receptor activity. The enriched pathways in inflammatory signaling, include NF-kappaB signaling pathway, HIF-1 signaling pathway, MAPK signaling pathway, and PI3K-Akt signaling pathway. Molecular docking further verified the strong binding abilities of PF to PI3K, Akt1, ERK1, ERK2, HIF-1alpha, TLR4, and NF-kappaB. In LPS-induced sepsis rat model, PF pretreatment inhibited PI3K/Akt/ERK-mediated HIF-1alpha and TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling, thereby reducing inflammation by decreasing the levels of tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) and interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta) in serum and cardiac tissue. Ultimately, PF ameliorated SIMI by improving cardiac pathological and functional changes and mitigating myocardial injury markers, such as lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), CK-MB, cTnT/TNNT2, TNNI3/cTn-I, and aspartate aminotransferase (AST). Collectively, the PI3K/Akt/ERK-mediated HIF-1alpha and TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB inflammation signaling appear to be the primary mechanisms through which PF exerts its beneficial effects on SIMI.
abstract_zh: 脓毒症诱导的心肌损伤（SIMI）显著增加脓毒症的死亡率。尽管芍药苷（PF）已被证明能改善脓毒症的生存率，但PF对SIMI的具体机制仍不明确。在本研究中，网络药理学揭示了PF与SIMI相关靶点之间的90个重叠靶点。使用分子复合物检测（MCODE）方法分析，识别出一个得分超过30的显著模块，包含前10个靶点：Akt1、STAT3、CASP3、BCL2、TP53、PTGS2、CXCL8、TLR4、CCL2和ICAM1。这些靶点参与炎症反应中的组织修复、凋亡、免疫以及脂多糖（LPS）免疫受体活性。富集的炎症信号通路包括NF-kappaB信号通路、HIF-1信号通路、MAPK信号通路和PI3K-Akt信号通路。分子对接进一步验证了PF与PI3K、Akt1、ERK1、ERK2、HIF-1alpha、TLR4和NF-kappaB的强结合能力。在LPS诱导的脓毒症大鼠模型中，PF预处理抑制了PI3K/Akt/ERK介导的HIF-1alpha和TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号通路，从而通过降低血清和心脏组织中肿瘤坏死因子-alpha（TNF-alpha）和白细胞介素-1beta（IL-1beta）的水平来减少炎症。最终，PF通过改善心脏病理和功能变化，并减轻心肌损伤标志物如乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）、CK-MB、cTnT/TNNT2、TNNI3/cTn-I和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）的水平，从而改善SIMI。总体而言，PI3K/Akt/ERK介导的HIF-1alpha和TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB炎症信号通路似乎是PF对SIMI发挥有益作用的主要机制。
